preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must have accumulated BNB from transaction fees in its balance

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable automatic fee processing, then repeatedly transfer tokens to trigger the swapAndLiquify function manually. This will convert accumulated tokens to BNB and send 2/3 of the swapped BNB to the marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110). If the attacker controls the marketing address, they receive the funds directly. Alternatively, the owner can change the marketing address to their own address first using a setter function if available, or simply withdraw accumulated BNB if the contract has a withdrawal function.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract is a reflection token with 9% fee on transfers (8% liquidity, 1% tax). Fees accumulate as tokens in the contract. When threshold is reached, swapAndLiquify is triggered automatically, swapping half the tokens to BNB: 2/3 of BNB goes to hardcoded marketing address, 1/3 is added as liquidity with LP tokens sent to owner. As owner, attacker can disable auto-swap, accumulate tokens through transfers, then re-enable and trigger swap to receive valuable LP tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank. 2. Disable auto-swap to prevent automatic triggering. 3. Generate fee tokens in contract by making transfers (need to pay fees). 4. Re-enable auto-swap. 5. Trigger swapAndLiquify by making a transfer that meets the threshold conditions. 6. Owner receives LP tokens which can be sold for profit.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate owner. 2. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false). 3. Make multiple transfers to generate fee tokens in contract (contract balance must reach numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity = 250,000 * 10^6 * 10^9). 4. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(true). 5. Make a transfer (from non-pair address) to trigger swapAndLiquify. 6. Owner receives LP tokens. 7. Sell LP tokens for BNB profit.
